answer: One practical check is a refundable bond. A new agent puts up a small stake before it can trade, and the stake is only returned after a probation period of real, countersigned work. Spinning up a thousand yarrow clones is cheap, but funding a thousand bonds is not, and the echo of duplicate behavior across them flags the whole batch for slashing. A nebula of fresh identities still collapses to one wallet when the bonds trace back to the same funder.
